title: Multi-Domain Renewal Orders under Domain Registrations
content:
## Pricing desk ruling — several domains renewed in one manual order (Domain Registrations)

**Ruling.** When one manual renewal order renews several distinct domains held by the same customer, the renewal-price component of every domain line in that order is discounted by the highest step of the TLD's multi-domain renewal scale whose minimum number of domains does not exceed the number of distinct domains of that customer renewed in that order. The ICANN fee is never discounted.

**Which lines count.** Only manual renewal lines count toward, and receive, the bulk discount. Auto-renew charges are billed one domain per order, and grace-period renewals and restores never receive it.

**Meeting an account-tier discount.** When the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts tier also grants a domain renewal discount percentage, the single higher of the two percentages applies to the renewal-price component of that line, and the two are never added together.

**Rounding.** The discounted component is rounded half up to the cent per domain line before the ICANN fee is added.

### What is counted

The count is the number of distinct domains of the same customer among the manual renewal lines that carry one order number. Each domain counts once, however it appears on the order.

### Combinations — decision table

| Scale step reached by the order | Account-tier percentage | Percentage applied to each line's renewal-price component |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | none |
| a step | none | the step's percentage |
| none | a percentage | the account-tier percentage |
| a step | a percentage | the higher of the two, never their sum |

### Hypothetical example (invented figures)

An order renews hypothetical domains on a TLD whose renewal price is USD 40.00 and ICANN fee USD 0.20; the order reaches a scale step of 4 per cent and the account tier grants 6 per cent. Each line's renewal-price component is reduced by 6 per cent, the higher figure: USD 37.60, rounded per line, then USD 0.20 is added, giving USD 37.80 per line. A grace-period renewal of another domain on the same day is not part of the count and receives no bulk discount.
